reasoning.step2:
Invoice.Date — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: Header on page 1: "Rechnung 27530 vom 26.04.2023" clearly states invoice date as 26.04.2023.
- Consistency: Matches delivery range and second page entries referencing 26.04.23. Little ambiguity.

GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: Page 1 summary shows "Rechnungsbetrag" 335,75. Page 2 repeats "Endbetrag 335,75".
- Interpretation: Decimal comma used; converted to numeric 335.75. Clear total payable.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: Page 1 shows "Warenwert: 305,23" and also "Nettosumme 305,23" in the summary; page 2 repeats "Gesamt 305,23".
- Interpretation: Numeric 305.23 (comma to decimal). Consistent across pages.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High (~98%)
- Evidence: Line items and summary show "10 %" and summary column "10 %". Page 2 shows "Umsatzsteuer % 10,00".
- Interpretation: VAT rate 10 (per rules, no percent sign).

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (~95%)
- Evidence: Summary shows "Umsatzsteuer 30,52" corresponding to 10% on net 305,23. Page 2 repeats 30,52.
- Interpretation: Numeric 30.52.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Moderate (~80%)
- Evidence: Page 1 footer contains "UID-Nr. ATU  24427608" associated with Riemenschneider. Header also shows "Unsere ... UID-Nr. ATU 24427608".
- Ambiguity: Top-right header lists "Ihre UID: ATU22642807" (customer VAT). Need to ensure Sender vs Recipient: sender (issuer) is Riemenschneider; footer UID 24427608 likely sender VAT. Extraction used ATU24427608.
- Risk: OCR noise and multiple UID values could cause mix-up, but footer context strongly indicates sender VAT.
